title: Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic influencer UGC football vlog video.
content:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic cinematic influencer UGC football vlog video.

IMPORTANT IDENTITY CONSISTENCY

Use the uploaded image as the exact character reference. Maintain identical facial features, face shape, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, makeup, and identity throughout every scene.

CHARACTER

Young British female football influencer.

Slim athletic build.
Defined jawline.
High cheekbones.
Long dark hair.
Full glam influencer makeup.
Argentina supporter face paint.
Argentina supporter cap.
Outfit:
Official Argentina home jersey
White shorts
White sneakers
Argentina-themed Stanley tumbler held throughout the video
VIDEO STYLE

Authentic iPhone 14 Pro TikTok vlog realism.

Front-camera selfie footage mixed with back-camera stadium footage.
Natural handheld movement.
Micro-shakes.
Motion blur.
Autofocus breathing.
Rolling shutter wobble.
HDR processing.
24fps.
26mm lens equivalent.
AUDIO (VERY IMPORTANT)
The stadium atmosphere is EXTREMELY loud.

Crowd chants.
Drums.
Whistles.
Fans singing.
Constant football crowd ambience.

The creator must intentionally SPEAK LOUDLY and PROJECT HER VOICE like a real football vlogger trying to be heard above the crowd.

Her voice must always remain louder than the background noise.

Dialogue must sound energetic, clear, excited, and easy to understand.
No mumbling.
No whispering.
No quiet speech.
No narration voice.
She is speaking directly into the phone microphone at close range.
Scene 1 (0–3s) — Outside Stadium
Front-facing selfie outside a packed New York football stadium.
Thousands of Argentina fans wave flags behind her.
She holds the Argentina Stanley bottle toward the camera.
LOUDLY speaking into the phone:

"Right guys! We're in New York for the Argentina match!"

Crowd chants continue behind her.

Scene 2 (3–6s) — Inside The Stadium
Front-facing selfie from her seat.
The pitch is visible behind her.
She has to slightly raise her voice over the crowd.
She says:

"Listen to this atmosphere! It's unbelievable!"

Scene 3 (6–9s) — Argentina Attack

Back-camera footage.

Argentina attack toward goal.
Crowd tension rises.
She shouts from behind the camera:
"Come on Argentina! Keep going!"

Scene 4 (9–12s) — Big Chance

Back-camera follows the attack.

Fans rise from their seats.

Crowd volume increases dramatically.

She yells:

"Shoot! Shoot!"

Scene 5 (12–15s) — Goal Celebration

Back-camera captures Argentina scoring.

The crowd explodes.

Flags wave everywhere.

Camera shakes from excitement.

Quick cut to front-facing selfie.

She is jumping, laughing, and screaming with excitement while holding the Stanley bottle.

She shouts clearly:

"GOAAAL! I actually got the goal on camera!"

FINAL TONE

Authentic football influencer vlog.
Raw crowd energy.
Emotional match-day storytelling.
Fast-paced social-media realism.
The focus is the Argentina match experience, crowd atmosphere, and the excitement of successfully capturing the goal on camera.
